text.EN: That's a lot of them. We fighting or going around?
text.TL: Ang dami nila. Lalaban ba tayo o iiwas?

text.EN: Big swarm ahead. What's the plan?
text.TL: Malaking kuyog sa unahan. Ano'ng plano?

text.EN: Whole herd in our way. Do we push through or find another path?
text.TL: Buong kawan ang nakaharang. Susugod ba tayo o maghahanap ng ibang daan?

text.EN: Look at the street. Are we engaging or avoiding?
text.TL: Tingnan mo ang kalsada. Lalabanan ba natin o iiwasan?

text.EN: Infected group is large. How do you want to handle this?
text.TL: Malaki ang grupo ng infected. Paano mo gustong harapin 'to?

text.EN: Crowd ahead of us. Should we fight or sneak past?
text.TL: May mga patay sa harap natin. Lalaban ba tayo o lulusot nang tahimik?

text.EN: There's quite a crowd. What are we doing?
text.TL: Medyo marami sila. Ano'ng gagawin natin?

text.EN: They're blocking the lane. Do we clear them or detour?
text.TL: Harang sila sa daan. Lilinisin ba natin o iikot tayo?

text.EN: Horde right in front. What do you want to do?
text.TL: Kuyog mismo sa harap. Ano'ng gusto mong gawin?

text.EN: That's more than a few. Engage or back off?
text.TL: Higit pa sa iilan 'yan. Susugod o aatras?
